text:
maria: Kicking off the region roll-forward now. Window 23:45-02:30 UTC. Image: inference:release-2026-03. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Each region: 10% canary for 10m, then 30% for 10m, then full if healthy. APAC remains pinned to inference:stable-2026-01 until we get a second healthy check due to thermal concerns. Post capacity + any abnormal telemetry.
deploy-bot: Launching US canary (slice=alpha-us). Smoke checks: canary-smoke, db-check, route-validate queued. CI logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/2767899999

tony: Capacity snapshot (just now):
US pool-us: spare qps 76%, idle GPU nodes 5/20, p95 baseline 88ms
EU pool-eu: spare qps 61%, idle GPU nodes 4/16, p95 baseline 115ms
APAC pool-apac: spare qps 38%, idle GPU nodes 1/10, p95 baseline 142ms
APAC thermal noted overnight on apac-node-3, ops flagged 1 warning event.

ash: tagged infra: apac-node-3 temps peaked at 82C for 15m last night. We should not ramp APAC beyond canary until ops confirms cooling. Also GPU memory fragmentation has been higher on that cluster.

infra_bot: Hardware advisory: apac-node-3 reported ECC warnings at 2026-03-20T02:10Z. Ticket INC-8421 created and assigned to infra-oncall.

ops_lead: Quick reminder of abort criteria: 1) error-rate >1% sustained for 5m, 2) p95 > 700ms for 10m, 3) any GPU OOM or ECC errors on the canary region. If triggered: immediate rollback of the affected slice and escalate to #incidents. Keep logs & traces attached.

maria: Acknowledged. Proceed US canary -> observe 10m. If green, ramp to 30% then EU canary start. APAC locked until infra confirms node health and spare qps >=50%.
deploy-bot: US canary smoke passed (all checks green). Increasing to 10% -> metrics streaming: error-rate 0.02%, p95 92ms, no OOMs.

ton y: (typo) meant tony: US looks healthy from metrics. Going to pre-warm an extra GPU for EU to avoid cold-start spikes.

ash: pre-warm ok. EU warm pool +1 node reserved. APAC: holding. ops oncall to review apac-node-3.

infra_bot: apac-node-3: post-maintenance telemetry shows temps back to baseline 64C. ECC warnings cleared at 2026-03-20T23:10Z. Update: disk SMART health degraded on that host — infra recommends keep node offline for further diagnostics.

ash: Given SMART degraded, we should not rely on that node. APAC spare nodes effectively 0/10 until replacement. Recommend pin.

ops_lead: Agreed. New APAC rule: require at least 2 spare nodes and spare qps >=50% before any ramp. If not met, we stay pinned and schedule a targeted warm pool for APAC next maintenance window.

maria: EU canary starting now (slice=alpha-eu) at 10%. Keep EU observation 10m then ramp to 30% if green. Ben, can you update the public status blurb that APAC is delayed due to hardware investigation?
eva: Status note prepared and queued: "Planned region rollout in progress. APAC deployment delayed pending hardware verification on a node; no customer impact expected at present." Will post if EU passes 30% check.
deploy-bot: EU canary smoke OK. EU metrics: error-rate 0.08%, p95 118ms, CPU steady. Ramp to 30% initiated.

ton y: EU ramp 30% looks clean. Small spike noticed in tail at p99 ~ 420ms for 2 samples, but not sustained. Monitoring.

ops_lead: Monitoring hooks live. Reminder: if p99 > 1000ms or error-rate jumps >0.8% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, rollback EU slice only.

maria: EU at 30% and stable for 12m. US at full. APAC still pinned. I'm leaning to do a final APAC check at 01:15 UTC (post ramp) — if infra confirms replacement node or warm-pool reserve and spare qps >=50%, we'll schedule APAC canary at 01:30 UTC.

ash: Infra: replacement host ETA 03:00 UTC, but we can carve a warm spare from other zones to give APAC 2 spare nodes by 01:00 if we accept cross-zone warm pools. That will cause slight latency due to cross-zone traffic for warmups.

maria: Let's avoid cross-zone warm pools tonight. We'll hold APAC and do a targeted maintenance tomorrow with full replacement. No cross-zone warmups.

ops_lead: Plan confirmed. Final state: US rolled, EU rolled to 30% and holding for final checks, APAC pinned to inference:stable-2026-01. If infra provides a clear health update earlier, we'll re-evaluate. Good job team. :thumbsup:

eva: I'll post the release notes summary and the APAC hold note to the status page now.

maria: Thanks all. Closing this thread — we'll open a new thread if we re-attempt APAC.
